description: This file defines a Rust module for temporal logic formulas, including data structures for formulas, violations, residuals, and an evaluator for temporal logic expressions in negation normal form (NNF). It supports operations like mapping functions over formulas, evaluating formulas at specific times, and stepping through residuals.

classes.name: Formula
classes.description: Represents temporal logic formulas in negation normal form, including logical operators and temporal operators like Next, Always, and Eventually.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents the evaluation result of a formula, including true, false with violations, or residuals.

classes.name: Violation
classes.description: Represents violations of formulas, such as false conditions, temporal violations, and logical violations.

classes.name: Leaning
classes.description: Indicates whether a residual is assumed true or false, with associated violations.

classes.name: Residual
classes.description: Represents residuals during formula evaluation, including logical combinations and derived temporal residuals.

classes.name: Derived
classes.description: Represents derived residuals for temporal operators like Once, Always, and Eventually.

classes.name: Evaluator
classes.description: Provides methods to evaluate formulas and residuals at specific times, supporting stepwise evaluation.

methods.name: combine_options
methods.description: Combines two optional values using a provided combining function.

methods.name: map_function
methods.description: Maps a function over the Function type within a Formula.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a formula at a given time, returning a Value.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Advances the evaluation of residuals at a specific time, producing a Value.
